scope: Targeted backward-citation and archive review, not an exhaustive systematic review of every Q/Kemp paper.

sources.citation: Warshel A., Weiss R. M. (1980). An empirical valence bond approach for comparing reactions in solution and in enzymes. JACS 102, 6218–6226.
sources.role: Foundational EVB Hamiltonian and solution/enzyme comparison.
sources.review: Bibliographic citation verified in Hong2018 reference27; not a source of Des27 input files.

sources.citation: Marelius J. et al. Q: a molecular dynamics program for free energy calculations and empirical valence bond simulations in biomolecular systems. J. Mol. Graph. Model. 16, 213–225.
sources.review: Bibliographic identity verified; software-method reference, not a Kemp parameter deposit.

sources.citation: Bauer P. et al. (2018). Q6: A comprehensive toolkit for empirical valence bond and related free energy calculations. SoftwareX.
sources.role: Q6 implementation and reproducible software version.
sources.review: Crossref metadata and Q6 source inspected; native Qdyn6/Qfep6 built at topology-recorded revision.

sources.citation: Frushicheva M. P., Cao J., Chu Z. T., Warshel A. (2010). Exploring challenges in rational enzyme design by simulating the catalysis in artificial Kemp eliminase. PNAS 107, 16869–16874.
sources.role: Calibration antecedent cited by Hong2018 reference15.
sources.review: Citation verified in Hong2018; full-text XML retrieval returned HTTP500. No additional numerical parameters attributed directly to this source.

sources.citation: Frushicheva M. P., Cao J., Warshel A. (2011). Challenges and advances in validating enzyme design proposals: the case of Kemp eliminase catalysis. Biochemistry 50, 3849–3858.
sources.role: Calibration antecedent cited by Hong2018 reference28.
sources.review: Citation verified in Hong2018; full-text XML retrieval returned HTTP500. No additional numerical parameters attributed directly to this source.

sources.citation: Hong N.-S. et al. (2018). The evolution of multiple active site configurations in a designed enzyme. Nature Communications 9, 3900.
sources.role: Original KE07 calibration/parameter source identified through Risso2020 reference59.
sources.review: Full Methods and complete 38-page SI inspected. SI Table10 at PDFpage23: Hij225, alpha−324 kcal/mol. Tables10–21 provide reactive parameter tables.
sources.reference_definition_note: Main text calls the aqueous reference substrate 4-nitrobenzisoxazole plus propionate for Glu101, while describing enzyme substrate as 5-nitrobenzisoxazole. Atom identity/convention must be checked rather than silently resolving this naming discrepancy.

sources.citation: Risso V. A. et al. (2020). Enhancing a de novo enzyme activity by computationally-focused ultra-low-throughput screening. Chemical Science 11, 6134–6148.
sources.role: Connects GNCA Kemp model to Hong2018 reference59 and reuses its solution calibration.
sources.review: Full-text Methods inspected through Europe PMC. Q5.10, older 100ps windows and no new reference calibration; not the later Q6/200ps protocol. RSC direct retrieval blocked403; supplementary bundle download was incomplete.

sources.citation: Gutierrez-Rus L. I. et al. (2025). Enzyme Enhancement Through Computational Stability Design Targeting NMR-Determined Catalytic Hotspots. JACS 147, 14978–14996.
sources.role: Updated Q6 protocol and actual GNCA input archive matching normalized reactive sections of the Des27 FEP files.
sources.review: Full EVB Methods and downloaded archive inspected. Authors explicitly report reactive Morse/LJ updates to reduce product-state instabilities. Archived qfep.inp gives constant100.4 and alpha−110. First-stage template recovered; no native Des27 trajectories supplied.

sources.citation: Listov D. et al. (2025). Complete computational design of high-efficiency Kemp elimination enzymes. Nature 643, 1421–1427.
sources.role: Target Des27/Des27.7 enzyme and reported Q6 barriers.
sources.review: Article/Methods, SI Table3 and re-downloaded EVB ZIP inspected. Reported Des27.7-IN13.2±0.6; not an original-energy-file reproduction.

sources.citation: Risso V. A. et al. (2017). De novo active sites for resurrected Precambrian enzymes. Nature Communications 8, 16113.
sources.review: Main Methods/data availability inspected: deposited transition-state-analogue force fields and MD examples are not a substitute for a complete reactive Des27 EVB model.

later_model.changes: Morse and van der Waals updates explicitly stated in main text; same normalized reactive sections as supplied Des27 inputs.

parameter_history.do_not_mix: Do not insert the older coupling/offset into the newer force field or claim updated-model solution calibration is validated merely because historical targets are known.

what_is_now_located: Historical aqueous-reference activation target and reported model definition.
Complete published older reactive parameter tables.
Updated reactive model inputs and analysis coupling/offset.
Recoverable related/sibling Q templates sufficient for a documented native reconstruction attempt.
still_unestablished: Original Des27 QFEP per-replica results/energy trajectories and original missing script contents/seeds.
Reference-system coordinates/topology/trajectories and activation plus reaction-free-energy evidence for the updated model in our changed OpenMM boundary.
Independent native 30-replica barrier reproduction and matched OpenMM convergence/Hamiltonian parity.
review_limitations: Older papers use different enzyme scaffolds and Q versions; they do not independently supply the Des27 target dataset.
The2018 main-text reference substrate naming discrepancy requires checking against actual structures.
Additional archive search hits for HG3 and functional descriptors are not treated as confirmed Q6/Kemp parameter sources without file-level inspection.

additional_archive_screening.title: Convergence in Determining Enzyme Functional Descriptors across Kemp Eliminase Variants
additional_archive_screening.inspection: Metadata lists KE07-R7-2 topology/coordinate files; 15.5MB ZIP not inspected. Not treated as a verified source of Des27 Q6 parameters.

additional_archive_screening.title: Enriching productive mutational paths accelerates enzyme evolution
additional_archive_screening.inspection: Metadata describes HG3 full-QM/QM-MM geometries and multi-GB HDF5 files. No claim these are Des27 Q6/EVB inputs; large trajectories were not downloaded.
